task_contract.requested: Eliminate mutation of an inspected Reader generation during ordinary lineage revalidation. Preserve explicit source/version attestation and fresh-generation initialization without overwriting existing artifacts.
forbidden: silently interpreting untouched areas as accepted

nodes.text: Default validate independently reconstructs canonical lineage and compares bounded no-follow regular-file reads. It never deletes, rewrites or repairs inspected generation artifacts on success or failure.

Explicit initialization uses exclusive directory-relative temp creation and no-replace linking. Preexisting artifacts including partial/symlink/directory entries are refused. Exercised write/link failures clean only matching inodes created in this invocation.

Fresh/unpublished status is caller responsibility, not proven by a boolean flag. Bootstrap adds the flag only in run_semantic_pipeline after mkdir(exist_ok=False); source-bound projector leaves default read-only behavior and propagates failure.

The six legacy test compatibility edits preserve all unrelated safety assertions. Existing deletion-on-failure expectations are deliberately replaced by exact preservation checks. F01 explicit version binding and resolver selection semantics are unchanged.

Supported Python3.14 synthetic execution covers 13 focused lifecycle/fault tests, 15 app E2E, 8 lineage, 17 resolver, 7 migration. A separate Python3.9 native XLSX security-partition fixture passes 1 method. None skips or expects failures.

This is F18 local acceptance only. Global snapshots, all concurrent same-user races, power loss/SIGKILL, all low-level fault paths, models/OCR, full package/embedded runtime and other V1 findings remain uncertified.
